author: Joanna Johnson
title: Big fun ahead: Summer day camps in New Iberia
text:
Summer vacation is finally here, bringing long sunny days, a break from school routines, and the perfect opportunity for kids to stay active.
Staying busy over the summer keeps boredom at bay, but while school is out, most parents still work as usual, turning the season into a balancing act of fun, structure and childcare.
Luckily, New Iberia is ready to entertain all ages, offering everything from sports camps to theater programs, as well as vacation Bible school and days filled with play and crafts.
Catholic High sport camps Whether your child is an all-star athlete or simply wants to try a new hobby, Catholic High offers camps for a wide range of interests.
Camps are open to all kids, not just those enrolled at Catholic High. Click the links to learn more about each camp or to register.
Baseball Camp , May 26-28 Ages 8-14 Camp times are from 8 to 11:30 a.m. Softball Camp , May 26-28 Ages 8-14 Camp times are from 8 to 11:30 a.m. Speed Camp , May 27 and 28 Ages 8-14 Camp times are from 1 to 3:00 p.m. Volleyball Camp , June 1-3 Ages 5-14 Camp times are from 8 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Girls and Boys Basketball Camp , June 1-3 Ages 5-14 Camp times are from 8 to 11:30 a.m. Offensive Lineman Camp , June 1, 3, and 4 Grades 5-12 Camp times are from 12 to 3:00 p.m. Girls Soccer 7v7 , Tuesday nights in June Grades 8-12 Boys Soccer 7v7 , Thursday nights in June Grades 8-12 Football Camp , June 8-10 Ages 8-14 Camp times are from 1 to 4:00 p.m. Middle School Strength & Conditioning Camp , Mondays and Thursdays, June 8-25 and July 6-16 Grades 6-8 Camp times are from 11:40 a.m. to 12:40 p.m. Boys and Girls Soccer Camp , Wednesday evenings, June 10-July 29 Grades 3-8 Camp times are from 5:30 to 7:00 p.m. Dance Camp , June 17-19 Ages 5-14 Camp times are from 8 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Cheer Camp , June 22-24 Ages 5-14 Camp times are from 8 a.m. t0 3:00 p.m. Drama Camp , July 6-10 Grades 2-8 Camp times are from 8 to 11:30 a.m. Girls and Boys Basketball Shooting Camp , July 6-8 Ages 5-14 Camp times are from 8 to 11:30 a.m. Summer Day Camp at the Event Center of New Iberia The Event Center of New Iberia is serving up seven weeks of summer excitement filled with fun, activities and memorable experiences.
Children ages 5–12 can look forward to a fun-filled week of camp featuring crafts, games, water days, movies and more.
Here are the camp sessions offered:
Week 1, June 8-12 Week 2, June 15-19 Week 3, June 22-26 Week 4, June 29-July 3 Week 5, July 6-10 Week 6, July 13-17 Week 7, July 20-24 Camp is from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Mondays-Fridays. Registration is $40, and weekly camp costs are $90 for the first child and $80 for each additional child.
Parents are asked to provide a lunch and snack for this child.
If you have any questions or want more information, contact Shawna Falgout at 337-369-1468 or theeventcenternewiberia@gmail.com.
Vacation Bible School at Highland Baptist Children in kindergarten through sixth grade can enjoy Vacation Bible School at Highland Baptist, where they learn Bible stories, play games, make crafts, and build friendships in a faith-filled environment.
This year’s theme, “Illumination Station,” invites kids to explore how light brightens, reflects, and reveals in exciting ways.
VBS is June 1-5 from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m., and will be held at Highland Baptist Church, 607 Victory Drive in New Iberia. You can register here .
4-H Robotics Camp If getting sweaty outdoors isn’t your child’s thing, challenge their mind instead with a week full of gadgets and gizmos galore.
Iberia Parish 4-H Robotics is hosting an exciting robotics camp where kids can bring ideas to life—building their own robot vehicles that zip and zoom, or designing robotic arms that can grab, drop, and place objects with precision.
Camp is held July 27-31 from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Highland Baptist Christian School, 708 Angers Street in New Iberia. Lunch will be provided.
To learn more, visit their Facebook page or email circuitbreakers23264@gmail.com.
Did we miss some? Let us know at joanna.johnson@thedailyiberian.com
